baselines.name: CacheQuant
expected_weights: CompVis latent-diffusion cin256-v2 checkpoint placed under mainldm/models/ldm
Original evaluation datasets from their official sources
environment_notes: Upstream ships environment.yaml targeting Python 3.8.5, PyTorch 1.7.0, and CUDA 11.0.
README example commands point to err_add/... but the checkout uses error_dec/...; manual path correction is required.
DDPM checkpoints are auto-downloaded by code, but LDM and Stable Diffusion weights must be placed manually.
baselines.reason: Not on the critical reproduction path because CacheQuant is a global caching and quantization accelerator, not a frozen-backbone verifier plus sparse repair baseline.

baselines.name: Dynamic-DiT (D2iT)
environment_notes: Official checkout has no environment file or setup instructions.
Use the RAS checkout as the runnable fallback until upstream releases code.
baselines.reason: Official checkout contains only README.md with 'Coming soon!' and no runnable code, setup files, scripts, or released weights.

baselines.name: DreamCache
expected_weights: Stable Diffusion 2.1 base checkpoint v2-1_512-ema-pruned.ckpt under models/ldm/stable_diffusion_v2
DreamCache pretrained adapter from the upstream Google Drive link
DreamCache synthetic dataset from the upstream Dropbox link
environment_notes: Upstream ships environment_dreamcache.yml rather than the environment.yaml filename used in the README.
Launch scripts contain placeholder checkpoint and dataset paths that must be edited before use.
Training and inference target Stable Diffusion 2.1 plus a learned DreamCache adapter.
baselines.reason: Not on the critical reproduction path because DreamCache targets personalized generation via feature caching and adapter training, not patchwise failure localization or sparse repair.

baselines.name: diffusers SDXL LoRA
environment_notes: Official example requirements include accelerate>=0.16.0, torchvision, transformers>=4.25.1, ftfy, tensorboard, Jinja2, and peft; the text-to-image example also requires datasets>=2.19.1.

Both pinned SDXL LoRA scripts in the official checkout enforce check_min_version("0.38.0.dev0"), so exact upstream reproduction should use the local diffusers checkout rather than only the PyPI diffusers pin from the T-LoRA environment.

The repo-local environment/rdlora-env.yaml is SDXL-first and tracks the T-LoRA-compatible base stack; upgrade peft and reinstall the local diffusers checkout in a disposable overlay when exercising the current text-to-image example on main.

baselines.name: ECT
environment_notes: Upstream README and env.yml target Python 3.9.18 and PyTorch 2.3.0.
Pinned local checkout is the main branch for CIFAR-10; upstream also documents an imgnet branch for ImageNet 64x64.
Repo-local environment/ect-env.yaml is the closest tracked environment match.

baselines.name: EasyRef
expected_weights: Hugging Face checkpoint repo zongzhuofan/EasyRef cloned into checkpoints
environment_notes: Upstream requirements pin diffusers 0.22.1, torch 2.3.1, torchvision 0.18.1, and transformers 4.45.2.
Repo-local environment/easyref-env.yaml mirrors the upstream package set and adds git-lfs plus deepspeed for model fetches and training launch scripts.
Upstream demo and training scripts target 1024 resolution with SDXL plus Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct.
baselines.reason: Not on the critical reproduction path because EasyRef is a multimodal reference-conditioned personalization system built on SDXL and Qwen, not a compressed latent diffusion repair baseline.

baselines.name: EfficientViT / DC-AE
environment_notes: Upstream README suggests conda create -n efficientvit python=3.10 then pip install -U -r requirements.txt.
No dedicated repo-local environment YAML exists for EfficientViT or DC-AE.

baselines.name: IntLoRA
launch_notes: Use the official train_dreambooth_quant.py or train_dreambooth_quant.sh flow without attempting an SDXL port.
Keep this baseline in its own SD1.5 appendix lane with 512 resolution and quantized DreamBooth settings.
Do not let IntLoRA block the week-2 SDXL gate unless an official SDXL path becomes obviously trivial.
environment_notes: Upstream ships environment.yaml for Python 3.9.18, CUDA 11.8, PyTorch 2.1.0, diffusers 0.26.0, accelerate 0.25.0, and peft 0.7.1.
The official README targets quantized DreamBooth fine-tuning and evaluation on Stable Diffusion 1.5 rather than SDXL.
Keep IntLoRA in its own appendix environment instead of folding its older CUDA and Stable Diffusion 1.5 stack into the SDXL-first RD-LoRA environment.
baselines.reason: Official repo and environment are verified, but the runnable substrate is quantized DreamBooth on Stable Diffusion 1.5 rather than the SDXL substrate required on the RD-LoRA critical path.

baselines.name: MPQ-DM
environment_notes: The official README delegates setup to the latent-diffusion environment instead of shipping a dedicated environment file.
The official calibration path requires a manual modification to ldm/models/diffusion/ddpm.py before quant_scripts/collect_input_4_calib.py is run.
The official substrate is LDM cin256-v2 quantization rather than SDXL, so this baseline stays appendix-only even after checkout verification.
baselines.reason: Not on the critical reproduction path because MPQ-DM targets low-bit latent-diffusion quantization and still requires a manual upstream code edit before its official calibration flow is runnable.

baselines.name: RAS
environment_notes: Upstream README suggests conda create -n ras python=3.12, python setup.py install, and pip install flash-attn --no-build-isolation.
The Stable Diffusion 3 example in the README uses use_auth_token=True for the upstream model load.
PyCuda is only needed when enabling index fusion.

baselines.name: Sana
environment_notes: Upstream quick start uses ./environment_setup.sh sana.
Repo-local environment/sana-env.yaml already includes diffusers support for SanaPipeline.

baselines.name: T-LoRA
launch_notes: Use the official SDXL train.py and inference.py entrypoints from the upstream checkout.
Keep resolution fixed at 1024 and stay on the SDXL path documented in the README.
This is the only critical-path external week-2 baseline.
environment_notes: Upstream ships tlora_env.yml with Python 3.11.11, diffusers 0.25.1, accelerate 0.26.1, torch 2.6.0, torchvision 0.21.0, transformers 4.37.1, and peft 0.7.0.
The official SDXL README uses stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0, --resolution=1024, and single-image customization on a single H100.
The official repo also ships a separate FLUX path under flux/, but RD-LoRA keeps only the SDXL path on the critical substrate.
